subject: AWS Marketplace private offer: unit price mapping and budget
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@brightcart.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Marketplace private offer & next steps (BrightCart / AWS)

Hi Tom -- thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

Meeting notes:
- Use case: BrightCart search + personalization embeddings for product catalog (real-time + async batch).
- Expected token profile: short prompts (50-200 tokens) for embeddings, some longer prompt generations for assistants (avg 350 tokens).
- Volume ask: pilot 8-12M tokens/month initially, targeting 50-70M tokens/month in Q3 (peak).
- Budget range: target $600-$1,200 / 1M tokens (customer target unit economics), total monthly budget target ~$30k-$70k in steady state.

Open asks / action items:
1) Can you confirm the 50-70M token target and whether procurement wants a private offer (AWS Marketplace) vs. standard invoice?
2) We shared a starter unit-price mapping (attached) - Rafael, can you review and propose AWS SKU-level mapping so BrightCart can map to their procurement pricing?
3) If BrightCart confirms private offer path, we'll coordinate a 3-way with the AWS Marketplace rep (Sophie) to set up the private offer & contract terms.

Attachments: marketplace-pricing-model.xlsx (unit-price draft), redwood-pricing-guidance.pdf (explainers).

Thanks - I can do a follow-up call early next week to walk through the SKU mapping.

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193
From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@brightcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@aws-partner.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Marketplace private offer & next steps (BrightCart / AWS)

Thanks Marissa - that aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications:

- Confirming target: yes, pilot ~10M/mo with expected ramp to ~60M/mo by end of Q3. The ramp is driven by two initiatives: search re-rank (real-time) and weekly batch embeddings refresh.
- Procurement preference: procurement would prefer an AWS Marketplace private offer so they can manage spend through our contract and get consolidated billing. They asked us to provide a SKU-level map that shows Redwood list price, suggested AWS Marketplace list price, and the recommended discount so they can understand unit economics at the invoice level.
- Timeline: procurement wants a private offer in place by mid-April to align with their Q2 budget. They also requested estimated monthly costs at 10M and 60M token volumes using the proposed unit prices.

I'll loop in our procurement lead next week if needed. Sophie - can you confirm available timelines for creating a private offer?

Tom
Sr. Product Manager, BrightCart
Tom.Harris@brightcart.com | +1 312-555-0146
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@brightcart.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-19T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Marketplace private offer & next steps (BrightCart / AWS)

Thanks Tom - copied suggested SKU/unit-price mapping below (high-level). This is intended to be a starting point you can present to procurement; we can iterate on exact SKUs with Sophie/AWS.

Proposed unit-price mapping (Redwood unit -> AWS Marketplace list guidance):
- Redwood target: $800 / 1M tokens (baseline tier). AWS Marketplace list price suggestion: $1,000 / 1M tokens; recommended marketplace discount: 20% -> net $800.
- Redwood volume-discount tier: $600 / 1M tokens (>= 50M tokens/mo). AWS list price suggestion: $750 / 1M tokens; recommended discount: 20% -> net $600.
- Add-on: Embeddings batch (lower compute intensity) suggested: $400 / 1M tokens; AWS list price suggestion: $500 / 1M tokens; recommended discount: 20% -> net $400.

Examples (monthly estimated spend):
- Pilot (10M tokens/mo) at baseline $800 -> ~$8k/mo (list price signal $10k/mo).
- Ramp (60M tokens/mo) mixing tiers (40M @ $600 + 20M @ $800) -> approx $40k/mo net.

Notes:
- We suggested a 20% marketplace list discount to preserve a clean list price while delivering your target net unit economics. Final discounting is handled through the private offer and can reflect committed spend.
- We'll produce a line-item CSV mapping Redwood price tiers to AWS SKUs for procurement (format they requested).

Action items: Rafael to produce SKU-level CSV; Marissa to schedule 3-way with Sophie to initiate private-offer setup. Aditya - any constraints from finance/legal on committed spend or minimum term we should flag?

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Pricing Analyst, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

3) Tom - can you ask procurement to confirm the mid-April target date and share the procurement contact? We'll include them on the 3-way.
